instruction: Navigate to HuggingFace's daily papers section for March 1, 2024, and expand the paper list in the .docx file. Add at least one more paper entry maintaining the format with Title, Authors, Abstract, and Arxiv PDF fields.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(1); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)
